findings.text: test_a_failed_admitted_launch_keeps_the_waits_it_recorded calls _record_queued_failure and _restore_queued directly, neither of which this diff changes, and never drives admit_once with a failing launcher, so a regression in the admission pass's own snapshot (for example taking it after the queued-life strip) leaves this arm green while the behaviour the done_when names breaks.

the module docstring promises that a stripped or failed launch leaves nothing binding on the reviewed run's review-records paths, and no test in the file touches a review-records path or a claim, so that clause of the done_when is asserted nowhere in the node's change.

QUEUED_LIFE_KEYS re-enumerates the six fields reckon/crew/promotion.py:1807 DISCARD_ADMISSION_KEYS already lists as the queued-life vocabulary, so the set of fields describing a queued request's life has two owners that can drift apart without either test failing.

baseline_suite records completed false at EXIT=4 because the new test file collects nothing at the base revision, and the importer arm was run at head only, so the done_when's 'add no failures against the base revision' is recorded as unmeasurable for the gate and left unmeasured for the importer population.
